title: Epimorphic maps from filtered cycle representatives
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K$ a cochain complex, and $F$ a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Let $p,n,r\in\mathbf Z$ with $p\le p+r$. Write $R=F^pK^n\cap d^{-1}(F^{p+r}K^{n+1})$, viewed inside $F^pK^n$, and let $Z_r$ be the cycle subobject of $\mathrm{gr}^pK^n$ defined in [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Put $S=F^pK/F^{p+r}K$. There exist epimorphisms $z:R\to Z_r$ and $g:R\to Z^n(S)$ such that $z$ followed by the inclusion in the graded piece is the graded projection restricted to $R$, and $g$ followed by the cycle inclusion is the quotient projection restricted to $R$. There is no hypothesis that $F$ is finite.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle-boundary formulas and Lemma 12.24.2 (current numbering); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: Evaluation preserves the quotient cokernel: its degree-n projection q is epic, and its kernel is the image of the inclusion of F^{p+r} into F^p. Pullback of kernels and the chain-map equation identify R with the inverse image under q of the cycle kernel of S.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle-boundary formulas and Lemma 12.24.2 (current numbering); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: The canonical pullback projection to this cycle kernel is epic by stability of epimorphisms under pullback. Compose the subobject equality isomorphism and the canonical kernel-to-cycles isomorphism to obtain g and its projection equation.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle-boundary formulas and Lemma 12.24.2 (current numbering); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: The graded projection kills F^{p+1}. Express the extra summand in the definition of Z_r as the image of its inclusion in F^p; image pushforward preserves sums, and pullback cancels pushforward along the mono F^p to K. Its image under the graded projection is zero. Therefore Z_r is image(R to gr^p), and the image factorization gives the epic z and the required equation.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_representative_epis (F : DecreasingFiltration K)
    (p n r : ℤ) (hs : p ≤ p + r) :
    let R := F.complexCycleRepresentatives p n r
    let Z := F.complexCycles p n r
    let S := F.complexQuotient p (p + r) hs
    ∃ (z : (R : C) ⟶ (Z : C)) (g : (R : C) ⟶ S.cycles n),
      Epi z ∧ Epi g ∧
      z ≫ Z.arrow = R.arrow ≫
        (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (Int.le_add_one (show p ≤ p from le_rfl))).f n ∧
      g ≫ S.iCycles n = R.arrow ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + r) hs).f n
